usageNotes: Use this to inspect the configuration of a specific realm-sync scheduled job by its job ID (a pve-configid string). The caller must hold Sys.Audit on the root path (/); API tokens are supported. This is a read-only call and returns immediately with the job definition object — no UPID or async behavior.

examples.summary: Read the definition of a realm-sync job named 'sync-ad-daily'

tips: Job IDs follow the pve-configid format: alphanumeric plus hyphens/underscores, no spaces.
To discover valid job IDs, list all realm-sync jobs first with get_cluster_jobs_realm_sync.
The returned object includes the realm, schedule, sync options, and remove-vanished settings — useful for auditing before triggering a manual sync.
